                                [--universe {csi300,sp500,nifty100}]
                                [--period PERIOD] [--top TOP]
                                [--horizon HORIZON] [--strict]
                                [--oos-split YYYY-MM-DD]
                                [--training-cutoff YYYY-MM-DD]
                                [--random-seeds RANDOM_SEEDS]
                                [--research-mode {explore,strict,locked}]
                                [--research-stage {factor_screening,single_factor_evaluation,neutralization,combination,composite_evaluation,backtest,monitoring}]
                                [--yes]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --zoo ZOO             Zoo to benchmark (required unless --yes is passed)
  --universe {csi300,sp500,nifty100}
                        Universe (NIFTY 100: nifty100; default: csi300; one of
                        csi300, sp500, nifty100)
  --period PERIOD       Period spec: YYYY-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD (e.g.
                        2020-2025)
  --top TOP             Top-N alphas to keep (default: 20)
  --horizon HORIZON     Forward-return horizon in bars, range 1-252 (default:
                        1 = next-bar). h>1 computes h-bar forward returns and
                        samples IC non-overlapping (end-anchored); 21 ≈
                        monthly, the conventional horizon for fundamental
                        factors.
  --strict              Strict gate: mandatory same-universe random control
                        (bench_runner_strict)
  --oos-split YYYY-MM-DD
                        Strict mode only: split train/test at this date for
                        the OOS confirmation gate
  --training-cutoff YYYY-MM-DD
                        Strict mode only: use this model training cutoff as
                        the train/test boundary
  --random-seeds RANDOM_SEEDS
                        Strict mode only: row-shuffled random controls per
                        alpha (default: 5)
  --research-mode {explore,strict,locked}
                        Declared research mode (default: strict for --strict,
                        otherwise explore; does not enforce locked evaluation)
  --research-stage {factor_screening,single_factor_evaluation,neutralization,combination,composite_evaluation,backtest,monitoring}
                        Research stage recorded in the factor-research
                        contract
  --yes                 Skip the 'bench every alpha?' prompt when --zoo is
                        omitted

/strategy-evidence:
usage: vibe-trading strategy-evidence [-h] {refresh,adapt} ...

Prepare strategy adaptations and refresh their evidence. Querying evidence
stays with the agent tools (list_strategies / query_strategies /
get_strategy_evidence).

positional arguments:
  {refresh,adapt}
    refresh        Rebuild the evidence cache from a JSON manifest of run
                   specs
    adapt          Prepare a child strategy for generation and backtest

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
/strategy-evidence/refresh:
usage: vibe-trading strategy-evidence refresh [-h] --manifest
                                              STRATEGY_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST
                                              [--json]
                                              [--scope {all,strategies}]

Rebuild the disposable strategy-evidence cache from real backtest run
artifacts. The manifest is a JSON object with a 'runs' array or a bare JSON
array of {strategy_id, run_dir, position_size?} entries. Runs failing the
ingestion gates are skipped with reasons; the rest still process.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --manifest STRATEGY_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST
                        Path to the JSON manifest of run specs
  --json                Emit the machine-readable envelope instead of a
                        summary
  --scope {all,strategies}
                        Replace all evidence, or only successful named
                        strategies

usage: vibe-trading strategy-evidence adapt [-h] --strategy-id STRATEGY_ID
                                            --name NAME --universe UNIVERSE

options:

  --position-sizing POSITION_SIZING
